evidence.quote: leading to the current tight labor market
the residential real estate market appears to be rebounding, with home prices leveling out recently, which has implications for our fight to lower inflation.
Much of that initial inflation has moderated, but it will be important to understand the long-term effect of the pandemic environment on household formation and housing demand going forward.
While we expect lower rents will eventually be reflected in inflation data as new leases make their way into the calculations
